name: game-party
description: /party: each subagent of the session with ACTIVE, CLEAR or FAIL, a bar of its tool calls and its job; opens by itself when one starts on a wide terminal

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off draws nothing; casual draws the party; hardcore adds failed calls and run time

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)

autoOpen.title: Open when a subagent starts
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself when the first subagent of a session starts (on terminals 144 columns wide or more)
